product.body_html:
Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch C925

Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (USA) | 9 Years 1 Month Aged | 64.5% ABV (129 Proof) | Uncut & Unfiltered | 750mL

Process & Profile

Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch C925 continues Heaven Hill’s renowned tradition of bottling bourbon straight from the barrel — uncut, unfiltered, and uncompromisingly bold. Aged for 9 years and 1 month, this batch represents a shift from the former 12-year minimum releases, allowing the whiskey’s true maturity and flavor balance to dictate its readiness.

Bottled at a robust 129 proof, Batch C925 captures the core identity of Elijah Craig’s mash bill (78% corn, 12% malted barley, 10% rye), offering a deep, complex profile full of sweet oak, baking spice, and caramelized richness. Matured in charred new American oak barrels, it delivers concentrated intensity, warmth, and structure while retaining the signature elegance that defines the Elijah Craig line.

Tasting Notes

  • Color: Deep amber with bronze highlights.

  • Nose: Layers of caramel, vanilla bean, toasted oak, and light fruit.

  • Palate: Bold and full-bodied with notes of dark toffee, brown sugar, baking spice, and roasted nuts balanced by sweet corn and charred oak.

  • Finish: Long and warming with lingering oak spice, caramel, and a hint of peppered heat.

What Makes It Special

  • Bottled uncut and unfiltered straight from the barrel at 129 proof (64.5% ABV).

  • Aged 9 years and 1 month, representing a new era in Elijah Craig Barrel Proof releases.

  • Drawn from Heaven Hill’s Kentucky rickhouses, where variation in climate drives natural depth and color.

  • Showcases Elijah Craig’s signature balance of oak spice, sweetness, and intensity.

  • A highly collectible release for bourbon enthusiasts tracking each batch evolution.

  • Continues the legacy of the “Father of Bourbon,” Reverend Elijah Craig, who first charred oak barrels to create this classic style.

How to Enjoy

Sip Elijah Craig Barrel Proof C925 neat to experience its true barrel strength or add a few drops of water to unlock caramel and spice layers beneath the heat. This bourbon pairs beautifully with rich desserts, dark chocolate, or a well-aged cigar. Its complexity and proof make it ideal for slow sipping and special occasions.

Frequently Asked Questions

  1. What is Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Bourbon Batch C925?
    It’s a 2025 release bottled at 129 proof, aged 9 years and 1 month, and presented uncut and unfiltered to preserve full flavor.

  2. What is the proof of Elijah Craig Barrel Proof C925?
    It is bottled at 129 proof (64.5% ABV).

  3. What does Elijah Craig C925 taste like?
    It delivers bold caramel, toffee, spice, and oak with a long, warming finish.

  4. How should I drink Elijah Craig Barrel Proof Batch C925?
    Enjoy neat or with a few drops of water to balance its intensity and reveal deeper sweetness.
